units.source_text: 总之，繁文缛节，童男童女不是游行一天就能完事。

en.t: In short, with all the elaborate formalities, the young boys and girls could not be finished after just one day of procession.

units.source_text: 他们还必须到彩车街挨家串户，登门拜访。

en.t: They also had to go to the float district, visiting each household door to door.

units.source_text: 节日典礼和童男童女的活动差不多得忙上一个月的光景。

en.t: The festival ceremonies and the activities of the young boys and girls kept everyone busy for nearly a month.
